messages:
perf-bot: [ALERT] Nightly CI - small-batch p95 increased 18% vs baseline (2026-03-18T02:10Z). Job: nightly/bench/small-batch. Link: https://dash.redwood.test/bench/12345
matt: saw this, thanks perf-bot. Which commit triggered the run? any obvious diff in kvcache or scheduler?
sara: commit range on that run is `a1b2c3d..f4e5g6h` per job metadata. I've attached the run log: https://ci.redwood.test/runs/67890
jordan: quick check — can someone grab the p95 distribution by sequence length? suspect long-tail inputs are higher
kevin: i'll spin up a local repro with that commit range. command: ```scripts/bench/run_small_batch.sh --commit f4e5g6h --samples 1000 --seq-dist=observed``` will report back in ~15
matt: @kevin add `--nvprof` or `--perf-trace` if possible so we can get kernel timings
kevin: noted, will try `--perf-trace`. if kernel-level traces look normal I'll check dispatcher changes
sara: also: recent PR #3245 touched kvcache eviction heuristics, rolling back that branch avoided a similar spike in staging last week
jordan: if kevin can't repro, can ops pull an archived machine image from the failing run? last time env drift caused noise
matt: ops — can you snapshot node `ci-runtime-13` from that run? @ops
perf-bot: Incident note: automated bisect scheduled in 10m if no ack. Trigger: nightly-bench-alert
kevin: ack, starting run now. will paste logs here.
kevin: (10m later) repro started. initial p95 after warmup = 1.18x baseline. uploading `profiling.tar.gz` to https://artifacts.redwood.test/kevin/4498765432
matt: thanks. @sara can you correlate this run with the kernel build id and cudnn version?
sara: build id `kernel-5.15.79-rt` and cudnn `8.4.1` — same as baseline
jordan: ok next step: can we run with kv-cache disabled to see delta? kevin, add `--kvcache=off`
kevin: running kvcache off now. will report in ~8m
kevin: kvcache off run p95 = baseline. suggests kvcache change
matt: great signal. action items: 1) @sara revert PR #3245 in a canary for next nightly 2) @kevin provide bisect candidates 3) @jordan prepare small telemetry eval to catch regression in CI
sara: on it, i'll prepare the rollback canary
kevin: i'll run bisect across the commit range and post candidate commits (expect ~6-8 runs)
matt: thanks team. I'll update the runbook and close the alert when canary completes. :thumbsup:
ops: snapshot requested, scheduled for 03:40Z
kevin: (final) bisect narrowed to `f4e5g6h` -> `b7c8d9e` which touches `kvcache/evict.go` line ~210. creating PR for a targeted revert and test
matt: perfect, we'll merge revert + smoke and watch tonight. filing followup incident note.
